purpose: Portable user-data schema and safe import template for the independent Supabase deployment.
why_private_records_are_excluded: Authentication users, password hashes, magic-link tokens, sessions, and user personal data must be transferred only through approved Supabase administrative procedures and with documented user consent.

auth_user_creation.supported_production_method: Create invited or magic-link users through the Supabase dashboard or a protected server-side administrative function.

columns.name: id
columns.description: ID returned by Supabase Auth after a user is created.

profiles.row_level_security: A signed-in user can read, create, and update only the profile matching auth.uid().

favourites.row_level_security: A signed-in user can manage only rows where user_id equals auth.uid().

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Set only to the signed-in sender.

enquiries.row_level_security: Anonymous entries must have a null user_id; a signed-in entry may only claim auth.uid().

agent_tasks.row_level_security: A signed-in agent can read and update only tasks where owner_id equals auth.uid().

import_sequence: Run supabase/schema.sql in the Supabase SQL editor.
Create or invite users through Supabase Auth; record the returned auth user UUIDs.
Insert matching profiles using those UUIDs.
Import user-owned favourites, enquiries, and agent tasks only after mapping every user_id or owner_id to the newly created UUID.
Validate row counts, role assignments, and RLS access in a staging project before production import.
